note: BH-7029: the time pq_gate may spend on its calls (the main tip read, restamp, the resolver's reads and dispatch) for one PR. When it passes during a read, that read is killed, no later call starts and the gate answers hold: the row stays READY and is asked again next tick, with one PREQUEUE_CALL_TIMEOUT line naming the call. A write in flight runs to its end. The value used is never above 3/4 of MC_STEP_TIMEOUT_S nor past the worker deadline minus 15 s. 0 = no bound (the behaviour before BH-7029). Per project: lane.merge-conductor.<project>.mc_prequeue_call_budget_s.
